name: AI Image Filename
description: Renames uploaded images to descriptive, SEO-friendly filenames using an AI vision model.
project_description: AI Image Filename renames uploaded images to short, descriptive, SEO-friendly filenames based on what the image actually depicts (e.g. golden-retriever-catching-frisbee-in-park.jpg instead of IMG_1234.jpg). It hooks Drupal's core FileUploadSanitizeNameEvent (at priority 10, before the default sanitizer) so that during any image upload the original file's bytes are sent to an AI Chat-with-Image-Vision model via the Drupal AI module, the model's suggested name is aggressively sanitized to a lowercase hyphenated stem, and the file is renamed before it is saved. It requires the AI module with a vision-capable provider; the model and prompt are configurable on a single settings page. No new routes, entities, or permissions beyond the AI module's own admin permission.
